# Decisions

- 2026-11-23: The current design source is the offline export folder `Okhati_desgn`; do not call Figma MCP. All 39 readable PNGs were copied without altering originals to `docs/design/screens/`.
- 2026-11-23: The 35 portrait exports are exactly 780 × 1688 px. The common device frame is 390 × 844 dp at 2× (780/390 = 2); four landscape title strips are flow notes and their scale is unknown.
- 2026-11-23: No `docs/design/DESIGN_NOTES.md` exists. Pixel sampling across every 4th pixel in all 35 screens found repeated exact colors: canvas #F7FAF9, surface #FFFFFF, primary #1F6F5C, ink #1B1F1E, pale green #E6F2EE, outline #E3EAE7, secondary #5B6663, success #2E9E6B, danger #D64545, insight surface #F3EEDA. Rare status fills also include #FCEEE3, #FAE8E8, #E9E9E9 and #FBF2DF. These are initial token candidates; retain AppColors as the only code location for hex values.
- 2026-11-23: Today.png shows 40 px left/right content inset on a 780 px frame (20 dp at 2×), repeated card width 700 px (350 dp); use 4 dp increments and preserve measured 20 dp inset. Typography line heights/sizes remain to be checked against individual screen exports during implementation.
- 2026-11-23: Further row sampling found common card/field radius 12 dp (first straight border pixel x=64 versus card edge x=40 at 2×), primary action radius 16 dp (top-edge inset 30 px, snapped to 16 dp), and bottom navigation height 84 dp. Shared tokens were aligned to these values.
